gates.per_run: Native soil/fixed count and IDs unchanged; no exclusion; all native finite,elastic;J>1-n0,n in(0,1),passive float density validity; current physical V/rho derived from J;actual fixed grid and all existing natural/pore/gradient necessary restrictions with no clipping/uplift. Energy ratio<=1.1 using native full XYZ velocity,stress,p,J,n,V/rho.
gates.independent_half: All257actual matched samples: pressureRMS<=5Pa,maximum XYZ material displacement<=.005mm; normalized pressureRMS/Pstar,fullXYZ velocityRMS/A anddisplacementRMS/Ustar each<=1e-4. Pstar=(Kw/n0)*A/cu0,Ustar=A/(cu0*2pi/.125),cu0 from actual float input moduli and initialmixturedensity,not rounded512. Initial native/material state exact.
gates.model_nonempty: For each full ON run max_native_time |J-1|>1e-8. For full model1 run both maximum native k span/k0 and maximum |k/k0-1| >=.005. Same-initial model1 minus model0 wall maximum pressureRMS >max(.001Pa,10*new measured model1 half pressureRMS). These are nonempty/resolution tests, not cross-option half/theory errors.
gates.constant_reference: Only model0 may use the retained constant-coefficient discrete/continuum reference. Periodic32 is an implementation control: its retained endpoint continuum pressure error is about-1.47159percent, so no new1percent accuracy claim/gate is imposed on it. The unchanged wall32 model0 retains its original1percent full-field/near-wall/endpoint objective. Model1 constant reference is diagnostic only. No independent variable-k exact continuum solution is invented.
gates.implementation_equivalence: If comparing canonical trajectories to retained same-initial private trajectories, require exact actual clocks and all26 common native physical/identity fields (read double SigmaState,not rounded legacy Sigma). Additional derived fields are checked against their own definitions. Do not compare mapped-J/privatep128 periodic tests or demand equality of run telemetry/zero-based metadata.
gates.wall_scope: Only actual static parallel axis FreeSlip planes; fixed physical position/velocity unchanged. The accepted private wall force/physical-face/no-flow/negative/source gates remain prerequisites and are inherited only through verified same-physics trajectory/source equivalence, not inferred from a half pass or first-layer velocity. No new general boundary or gravity balance claim.
